name: Case Page Declutter
author: Daniela & Alex
description: Hides the Case icon and the "Support Console" app name (and optionally the org logo), makes sidebar cards and columns collapsible, adds console tab controls, shows the case description below the highlights, and flags red accounts with a chip in the case header.

settings.title: Hide the org logo in the global header
Show a Red Account chip on case pages
settings.description: Shown when the account had open red account issues when the case was created (the case's Open Red Account field).
